text_block_list.text:
The decisive battle.
The day of the Oaks—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, this year's Oaks looks
like it's gonna be wild too!
Who's gonna take it...?!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Will it be Loves Only You on the rise, the consistently solid Chrono Genesis, or someone else entirely...?! This'll be a sight to see~!

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ugh~...!
As expected of the Oaks,
the crowd size is seriously insane~...!

text_block_list.name: Passionate Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I'm super happy that Loves-chan is getting so much attention, but...
I hope she doesn't get too nervous..."

text_block_list.name: Community Members
text_block_list.text:
"『Is the race starting soon?』 『Omg so nervous』
『I'm at the venue!』 『Go Loves-chan! ↑』
『She's got this!』 『Sending my energy!!』"

text_block_list.name: Cheers
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOH...)

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: (...I wonder why. The cheers from the racetrack sound so loud today—)

...Loves Only You was able to enter today's
Oaks in the absolute best condition possible.
And yet—

Her fighting spirit is certainly there.
And yet, somehow...
she still seemed precarious.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm sorry for worrying you.
Physically, I'm completely fine."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's just—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder why. Today, the sounds of the racetrack
feel just a little louder than usual.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
This won't do. I have to focus more.
Today is the all-important "Oaks", after all...!

Loves Only You had pushed herself relentlessly, treating today's race as her ultimate goal.
Naturally, she had deeply invested feelings in it.

And that magnitude might be putting pressure
on her in some way right now—
choice_data_list: ...Loves, close your eyes one more time.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-What?
choice_data_list: I want to help you focus.
I want to help you focus.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...My eyes are closed.
choice_data_list: ...Try saying the names of the commu members.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Everyone's names?
...Harukaze-san. Iwashi Dango-san.
Mikka Bouzu-kei Joshi-san. Nekomimi Kamen-san—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"...Rata-san. Ai Oshi Samurai-san.
Extra-Help Mash-san. Night Shift Regular-san.
Yumikawa-san. Ichigo-san. Passionate Teacher-san."
Loves Only You carefully recalls the names of each and every community member, one by one. Eventually—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Syrup-san. On that last stream,
they complimented me, saying I look really cool
on the racetrack...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Did Shoyu-Inu say he bought an arcade stick
during our chat the other day?
I wonder which brand it was—
Along with the names, memories came flooding back one after another. Loves Only You's demeanor gradually softened into something gentler, and—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ...Strange.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
While thinking about everyone...
that sound that was so loud just a moment ago
is fading away...
choice_data_list: Okay, here's a little question for you!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Huh? What is it, what is it?
choice_data_list: So, what do you think my commu name is?
Care to guess what my handle is?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: ………………Miss "Bridge."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: The person who guided me this far.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Hehe♪
choice_data_list: ..."We" will always be right beside you.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Thank you.
—I'm fine now...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go show them.
My biggest, greatest love right now!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm off!!
âLoves-chan.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Chrono-chan...! Bouquet-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...Impressive, as always.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Love-chan right now...
Her spirits seem... more fulfilled
than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Can you tell?
Right now, I'm burning with the absolute purest love.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: So I might end up burning the two of you as well...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: ...I accept that challenge.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—I've finally... made it to a place
where I can compete alongside everyone.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Today, to add color to the bouquet I wish to deliver...
I will clash against you with everything I have.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: It's truly a clash of love, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I have people I want to deliver my love to as well...
Someone I want to share it with, right at the very front of the crowd.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Today's Oaks.
Let's color it the most brilliantly in history with our running♪

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: —And I'll be the one standing at the top!
